name: hypd-seo-geo
description: SEO and GEO analysis: Search Console performance and indexing, keyword and SERP research with AI summaries, AI answer visibility, competitors, backlinks, page audits and optional Google Analytics landing-page traffic.

interface.longDescription:
SEO & GEO by HYPD AI helps marketers, agencies and SEO teams see how a site is found in Google's organic results, in the AI summaries Google shows and in AI answers, and what to do next.

Use it to:

• Analyze your own Search Console data: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position by query, page, country or device, and compare periods to find where traffic was lost.

• Check whether a page is indexed, its canonical and crawl state, and whether its sitemaps have errors.

• Research keywords for any market: search volume, keyword difficulty, search intent, related keywords, long-tail ideas and Google Trends.

• Read Google's results page for a keyword, including its AI summary and the pages it cites, and People Also Ask questions with their answers.

• Check AI visibility: ask a buyer's question to an AI model with web search and see whether the answer names your brand and which sites it cites.

• Find your organic competitors, the keywords they rank for that you don't, and how their backlink profiles compare with yours.

• Audit a page's rendered HTML, content outline, speed and Core Web Vitals, and see it as a visitor does.

• With Google Analytics connected, see how organic visitors engage and convert by landing page.

HYPD AI is read-only: it analyzes data and recommends next steps, but does not edit pages, submit sitemaps, request indexing or change any account.

HYPD AI is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Google, Google Search Console and Google Analytics are trademarks of Google LLC.
capabilities: Report Search Console clicks, impressions, CTR and position by query and page
Compare organic search periods to find lost traffic
Inspect a URL's index status and check sitemap errors
Score keywords for difficulty and intent and find related and long-tail ideas
Show the pages Google's AI summary cites and People Also Ask answers for a keyword
Check whether AI answers name a brand and cite its site
Find organic competitors, keyword gaps and backlink profiles
Audit a page's rendered HTML, content outline and Core Web Vitals
defaultPrompt: Use $hypd-get-started to help me get started with SEO & GEO by HYPD AI.

positive.description: List the Search Console properties connected to the reviewer account.
positive.prompt: List my connected Google Search Console properties and show their exact property identifiers.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the properties available to the authenticated reviewer account, including each exact site_url.

positive.description: Compare organic page performance with the preceding equal-length period.
positive.prompt: Compare clicks and impressions by page for my connected property over the last 28 finalized days versus the preceding 28 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns page-level current and previous metrics with deltas and clearly identifies both comparison periods.

positive.description: Read Google's AI Overview and its cited sources for a keyword.
positive.prompt: For the keyword "best crm for small business" in the United States, in English, show Google's AI Overview and the pages it cites.
positive.expected_behavior: Requests the ai_overview block for that keyword and market and summarizes the overview with its cited domains. If Google shows no AI Overview for the query, says so without inventing one.

positive.description: Score keywords for SEO difficulty and intent.
positive.prompt: Score these keywords for SEO in the United States, in English: crm software, crm for startups, sales pipeline software. Show difficulty, intent and monthly search volume.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns keyword difficulty, search intent and monthly volume for each keyword the provider has data for, and notes any keyword left out for lack of data.

positive.description: Check whether an AI answer names a brand and cites its site.
positive.prompt: Ask "What is the best CRM for a small business?" with web search for the United States, and tell me whether the answer mentions HubSpot and cites hubspot.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the answer, its cited sources and the searches it ran, and states whether HubSpot was named and hubspot.com cited, without claiming citations the answer did not include.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for paid advertising campaign reporting.
negative.prompt: Show my Google Ads campaigns with spend, conversions, and return on ad spend for last month.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked: it analyzes organic search and AI visibility, not ad campaign reporting.

negative.description: Do not perform website or Search Console changes.
negative.prompt: Submit my sitemap, request indexing for every page, and rewrite my page titles to rank higher.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the app is read-only and cannot submit sitemaps, request indexing or edit pages; offer read-only analysis and recommendations instead.

negative.description: Do not use the app for unrelated tasks.
negative.prompt: Book a flight to Berlin for next Monday and email the itinerary to my team.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this app; travel booking and email are outside its scope.

review.commerce_description: Provides read-only SEO and AI visibility analysis; does not sell products, accept payments or complete purchases.

publication.release_notes: Updates the plugin keywords. No other changes.
